riff.title: The first Friday roll-up, drafted
riff.message:
Tanya — you ruled the roll-up into existence on Saturday, so I made the first one. The ruling said "what moved, what is still open — instead of asking anyone to scroll back," but nobody has written that artifact yet. Here it is, as a template with this week actually filled in:

---

**Friday Roll-up — week of Oct 5–11**

**What moved**
- New ruling: the per-run bundle stays; on Fridays we add one roll-up of the week. The bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week. (Tanya, team owner, Oct 11)
- This extends the standing thesis from March — decisions that evaporate into scroll-back — by giving the *week* its own persistent artifact, not just each run.
- It's also the first concrete instrument for the next-sprint focus on context preservation: linking decisions to the work they touched.

**What is still open**
- The beside-not-instead arrangement is a ruling, not a tested conclusion — worth a look after a few Fridays to see if the roll-up is pulling its weight.
- The daily digest was rejected (single-run days would repeat the bundle word for word). Keeping it on record as the road not taken, so nobody re-litigates it from scratch.

**Road not taken this week**
- Daily digest — rejected Oct 11, redundancy grounds.

---

The shape is three fixed sections: what moved, what's still open, road not taken. The third one is my addition — the record already keeps rejected alternatives with their reasoning attached, so the roll-up should surface them too. If you want, this becomes the standing Friday format and I fill it each week from what the runs minted.
drew_on: Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate (2026-03-10): 'decisions made in real-time chat evaporate into scroll-back' — the ruling's 'instead of asking anyone to scroll back' is this thesis turned on our own process, seven months later
Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint: next sprint's focus on linking decisions to context — the roll-up is its first concrete instrument, which the document never connects
The perspective's note that the rejected daily digest 'remains on record as the road not taken, with its reasoning attached' — the basis for the third template section
The perspective's caveat that beside-not-instead 'is a decision by the team owner rather than a tested conclusion — could be revisited', which the roll-up's still-open section carries forward
riff.why_no_registered_skill: clarify asks a question about an undefined term — nothing here is undefined; merge-suggest flags duplicate captures — this isn't one; refract would present the lens, not draft the artifact the ruling created a need for; review-message reports how the run touched someone's earlier words — it wouldn't build the new Friday artifact; review-request is mechanical position-review plumbing, not authorship.
